title: fix: pin Open WebUI container to ENAM and cache the model list
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Pins the Open WebUI container to `ENAM` (`constraints.regions`), next to Postgres in us-east-1. It had started in Riga, so every DB session cost ~3 transatlantic round trips (~0.45 s) and a page load took ~20 s.
- Sets `MODELS_CACHE_TTL=300`: the upstream default of 1 s rebuilt the ~360-model list on every page load (6–8 s per `/api/models`).
- Documents placement and the ~5 min 500/503 rollout gap in the README.
- Verified on staging: `/health/db` 0.9 s → 0.3 s, `/api/config` 1.4 s → 0.4 s, egress moved from Riga to Ohio. gen's own `/v1/models` was measured at ~0.1 s throughout; the API was not the cause.
- Production applies on the next `Deploy / Applications` run from `production`; the single instance rolls to the new region with ~5 min of downtime.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The models stopped migrating
gist.blurb: Open WebUI moved in next to its database and learned to keep the model menu around for five whole minutes. The hive no longer sends every page load on a transatlantic field trip.
gist.summary: Pinned the Open WebUI container to ENAM alongside its us-east-1 Postgres database and set MODELS_CACHE_TTL=300, avoiding remote database round trips and rebuilding the roughly 360-model list on every page load.
gist.impact: Open WebUI pages should load much faster: staging database health checks fell from 0.9 s to 0.3 s, config requests from 1.4 s to 0.4 s, and the model-list cache now serves repeated requests for five minutes.
